title: The stained-glass desert
alt: An arched stained-glass window turns dunes, an oasis and a palm tree into a luminous desert landscape.
description: Precise spatial composition and intricate glass craftsmanship, with coloured light falling onto stone.
prompt: A complete large stained-glass window depicting a fantastical desert landscape: ochre dunes flow into a deep-blue oasis, a dark green date palm rises at the left, a luminous ivory moon hangs above, and a small terracotta settlement occupies the lower right. Hundreds of translucent glass pieces separated by fine connected lead seams, richly varied glass texture, warm sunlight projected onto a pale stone floor. Symmetrical arched outer frame, view straight on, exquisitely crafted architectural photograph, no text.
